name: Honey Cake
desc: A sweet cake of the kind left as an offering.

name: Bronze Ingot
desc: A heavy bar of good bronze.

name: Bronze Ring
desc: Flawless work. It is warm to the touch.

name: Kappa Ointment
desc: A secret river remedy. Restores 80 HP.

name: Jug of Sake
desc: Rice wine in a fat clay jug. An oni can smell it a mile off.

name: Roasted Soybeans
desc: A measure of fukumame, roasted for Setsubun. Thrown, they drive out oni.

name: Bowl of Cream
desc: Thick fresh cream, the kind left out overnight for a hardworking hob.

name: Fine Linen
desc: A bolt of clean white linen, fit to wrap the honored dead.

name: Wisp Ember
desc: A spark from a coal out of Hell, shut in a horn lantern. It never goes out and never gives any warmth.

name: Love-in-Idleness
desc: A little western flower, purple with love's wound. Its juice on sleeping eyelids makes the sleeper dote on the next creature he sees.

name: Lucky Mallet
desc: An oni's uchide no kozuchi, dropped as he fled. Shake it and make a wish.

name: Heart Scarab
desc: A green stone scarab inscribed with a plea to one's own heart: do not stand up as a witness against me.

name: Buzhou Shard
desc: A chip of Mount Buzhou, the broken pillar of heaven. It always leans a little to the northwest.

name: Bead of Return
desc: Brings a fallen demon back with half its HP.
